cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Back Me Up
cards.instruction: Recruit someone to support your version of how an ordinary responsibility should be handled.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought it was yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There was a new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For a wedding cake, we weigh the flour. Please put that mug down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's quicker. I've used three mugs already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. Show me the mug, and I'll weigh one mugful.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I used three different mugs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Please fetch all three. Apparently we're measuring the crockery before we can measure the flour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm tuning this piano. Please leave the keys alone while I listen.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm checking the sticky ones so you can fix those too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. Mark them with these little stickers. Silently, please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Done. Shall I peel them off so you can play?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One at a time. After I reach each key. We've nearly invented a system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the house meeting, back me up about the bins being Alex's turn.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought it was yours.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Only on the old rota. Remember the new conversation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There was a new conversation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're having it now. Try to remember it confidently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell the manager we agreed I'd cover the morning, not the evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wasn't in that meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you have no conflicting memory.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm not lying for you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you look thoughtfully unsurprised while I explain?

cards.title: Pick a Priority
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between two ordinary obligations that both supposedly cannot wait.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Your parents' gravy needs stirring and you need a lift to the station. Which am I doing?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't you leave dinner on a timer?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. It won't stir the gravy. Do I finish their dinner or drive you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Finish dinner. I'll book a taxi. Just carry my suitcase downstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose again: suitcase downstairs now, or gravy without lumps for your parents?

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: I'll pay. Put lunch in that exact slot, in pen. You've used pencil for me since school.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you leave quiz night for your sister's first exhibition opening?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm captain. They'll think I've abandoned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them your sister needs you. I'd like that to outrank geography.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave after round one and say I've got a headache.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come after round one, but tell them it's for me. I want to rank above geography, not below a headache.
